evidence_spans.source_text: As shown in Fig. 5(c, d), restricting supervision to the first quarter substantially slows convergence and reduces final accuracy, whereas training on full trajectories achieves the best peak accuracy.

As shown in Fig. 7, Semi-OPD maintains a larger fraction of such tokens than OPD throughout training. This indicates that Semi-OPD exposes the student to more teacher-preferred tokens, i.e., more on-policy w.r.t. the teacher, whereas OPD more often produces signals that suppress the student’s own sampled tokens.
